verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own network-token lifecycle webhooks, sent when cardholders add Adyen-issued cards to wallets such as Apple Pay or Google Pay and the card data is replaced with a network token. That gives developers event-level visibility into tokens created for a card. Nothing in the pack shows tokens as a manageable resource beyond these events. Missing for 10: an API to list or retrieve tokens per card, wallet/merchant token-requestor attribution in token data, independent token suspend/revoke separate from the PAN, and any hands-on corroboration.
